extracted.intended_audience: researchers (authors, reviewers, and editors) considering submission or participation in Frontiers journals
extracted.subtask_description: Publisher-level description of how Frontiers handles peer review, including reviewer selection, quality checks, editorial oversight, integrity screening (human + AI), and the interactive author–reviewer workflow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer appointment and qualifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Peer review is handled by active researchers, carefully appointed according to strict excellence criteria, and who certify the validity of research with their names on the published article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers are subject experts; appointment follows strict excellence criteria to ensure expertise and accountability (names of reviewers appear on published articles).

rubrics_metrics.name: Methodological rigor
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewers evaluate the methodology of a study for rigor, and ensure the research provides valid conclusions supported by sufficient data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess methods for rigor and whether the presented data sufficiently support the conclusions; this is a core element of the quality assessment performed by reviewers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of a quality assessment tool / dedicated review questionnaire
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewers evaluate manuscripts using our quality assessment tool and follow a dedicated review questionnaire which ensures their review is constructive and is focused on quality and the validity of results – not perceived impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Structured questionnaire steers reviews toward constructiveness and validity-focused assessment rather than subjective measures of perceived impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial oversight and endorsement
rubrics_metrics.description: Editors are well-known and respected leaders in their field and assess the process and manuscripts meticulously. They only endorse publication if the reviewers validate the contents of a manuscript.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editors scrutinize both the review process and manuscript content and make publication decisions contingent on reviewer validation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency and accountability (named reviewers/editors)
rubrics_metrics.description: The names of reviewers and editors appear on published articles, encouraging them to act responsibly and in the best interests of the final article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open acknowledgement of reviewer and editor identities is used to promote responsible behavior and transparency in the review process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interactive collaborative review (author–reviewer dialogue)
rubrics_metrics.description: With our online forum, authors can have a constructive conversation with reviewers and editors in real time, working together to make improvements to the manuscript.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Real-time online dialogue enables quick iterations, facilitates consensus, and supports collaborative improvement of manuscripts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Automated integrity screening (AIRA) prior to peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: AIRA, our AI-powered integrity tool, built into our platforms and processes to support editors, reviewers, and our teams with the review process. AIRA runs 40+ checks before peer review, flagging potential issues like plagiarism, image manipulation, and fabricated content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: AI flags a wide range of potential integrity issues early; these flags are used as alerts for human follow-up, not as final judgements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human-finalised judgements on integrity issues
rubrics_metrics.description: The final judgement is always made by a human.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although automated checks run, humans (editors/reviewers/research integrity team) make the final decisions about flagged issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Active research integrity investigations during review
rubrics_metrics.description: Our research integrity team investigates any allegations or signs of misconduct or peer review manipulation during the peer review itself. This includes citation manipulation, false reviewer identification, conflicts of interest, and any activity that may unduly influence the outcome of the review process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investigation covers a list of manipulation and misconduct types; scrutiny can occur during peer review and may affect outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fairness and objectivity (VALID criteria)
rubrics_metrics.description: Our peer review process is objective, rigorous and transparent. All decisions are made in accordance with our VALID criteria, giving all valid science the opportunity to be published.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviews are intended to focus on validity and quality rather than perceived impact; the publisher references an internal VALID framework to guide decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeliness and efficiency
rubrics_metrics.description: A timely and efficient approach. Our custom-built peer review platform guides you smoothly through the review process and alerts you when any action is required. Thanks to this, our average review time is under 90 days.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Platform features and a dedicated peer review team are used to keep the process efficient; authors can expect an average turnaround time of under 90 days.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer self-assignment with editorial vetting
rubrics_metrics.description: Our self-assignment tool enables Frontiers' reviewers to browse manuscripts that have been submitted to our journals, identify submissions that match their expertise, and offer to review them. The platform also allows editors to maintain control of the peer review process: all community reviewers that volunteer through the platform are vetted by our associate editors, specialty chief editors, or field chief editors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combines reviewer convenience (self-assignment) with editorial control (vetting) to match expertise and ensure review quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: In-house peer review team support
rubrics_metrics.description: The whole process is supported by our experienced in-house peer review team. The team upholds and ensures high quality standards for manuscripts and the review itself, certifying the quality, scientific rigor, and validity of articles and promoting a constructive discussion among authors, reviewers, and editors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dedicated staff oversee process integrity, support stakeholders, and act to maintain consistent standards across manuscripts.
